tasks.label: Run analysis interaction tests
tasks.command:
cd /home/t/tdc266/FluoroSuite && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -c "
import sys, os
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'offscreen'
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from fluorosuite.pages import AnalysisPage
from fluorosuite.theme import STYLESHEET
from fluorosuite.visualization import DarkFieldCorrection
from fluorosuite.config import DARK_FIELD_FILE, LIVE_DIR
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

app = QApplication(sys.argv)
app.setStyleSheet(STYLESHEET)

LIVE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
correction = DarkFieldCorrection.load(DARK_FIELD_FILE)
page = AnalysisPage(LIVE_DIR, correction)
page.resize(1500, 940)
page.show()
for _ in range(5): app.processEvents()

# Test 1: Small window
page.resize(800, 600)
for _ in range(5): app.processEvents()
stamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
outdir = Path('captures/exports')
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
page.grab().save(str(outdir / f'analysis_small_{stamp}.png'))
print(f'Saved: analysis_small_{stamp}.png')

# Test 2: Very small window
page.resize(600, 450)
for _ in range(5): app.processEvents()
page.grab().save(str(outdir / f'analysis_very_small_{stamp}.png'))
print(f'Saved: analysis_very_small_{stamp}.png')

# Test 3: Large window
page.resize(1920, 1080)
for _ in range(5): app.processEvents()
page.grab().save(str(outdir / f'analysis_large_{stamp}.png'))
print(f'Saved: analysis_large_{stamp}.png')

# Test 4: Narrow window (force pipeline drawer to be narrow)
page.resize(500, 800)
for _ in range(5): app.processEvents()
page.grab().save(str(outdir / f'analysis_narrow_{stamp}.png'))
print(f'Saved: analysis_narrow_{stamp}.png')

page.close()
print('Done')
"
